reviews.body: Ben and Mike we're absolutely spectacular! Super duper, knowledgeable and helped heal my herniated disc! I couldn't be more pleased with the service I received!
I can't say enough positive things about Ben and his team at RPT. I came in with chronic issues of back and hip pains. It took only about 6 appointments for me to be convinced...

Having a lower left hip issue as I am in dentistry and alot of my days include bad posture to make patients comfortable. Ben and his team took such good care of me. I felt better instantly and feel like I have a new beginning...

These miracle workers exhibit the best patient care I've ever experienced. They heal people! My dedication to Robotic Precision Therapy, Ben Blankenship and his staff is cemented by experiencing healing.

I came with completely blocked hip flexors to the point I could not train anymore, among a bunch of other blockages. This incredible technology and the knowledge of the team fixed me up and I will be back for sure if it happens again.

I can not express enough gratitude and hopefulness that I am feeling right now after going to Robotic Precision Therapy Clinic! I have a few years long suffering injuries(ankle ligament, torn meniscus, neck, pelvic alignment) due to being in the military, being a runner...

I came to my first therapy session with very little expectations, because I've been in pain for 15 plus years. I've been to many Dr's and other alternatives with no change. Someone recommend this to me and I am so glad they did!

had a severe herniated disc. My massage therapist recommended RPT. I gave it a try and now have almost 100% movement back in my shoulder. I thought I was going to have surgery but this therapy is a dream and works without any invasive surgery and I couldn't be happier.

This is not miracle work, it is science! I had terrible back and knee pain. It's not just the robot, but the knowledgeable practitioners who helped heal me within a few weeks. I've been pain free now for 6 months and go back once every few months.
